title: Stock-Rotation Rates for Long-Standing Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
**Returns terms — Ship-To Fulfillment Account, stock-rotation rate for established delivery locations.**

The rotation rate follows the ship-to's level and tenure: 10 percent for a ship-to holding Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To whose opened date is at least 60 whole months before the request date; 7 percent for a ship-to holding Corbett Priority Ship-To or Corbett Standard Ship-To whose opened date is at least 60 whole months before the request date. The rotation rate is the percent of the rotation purchase base that gives the gross allowance.

Every other ship-to — one holding Corbett Parcel Ship-To, one open fewer than 60 whole months, or one with no opened date — is not given either of these rates.

### Terms used

- *Level* — the service level the ship-to holds on the request date, as the ship-to lookup shows it.
- *Tenure* — whole months from the ship-to's opened date to the request date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

### Rate table

| Level held | Opened at least 60 whole months before the request date | Rotation rate under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To, Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | yes | 10 percent |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To | yes | 7 percent |
| any of the above | no, or no opened date | neither rate |
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | either | neither rate |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A Corbett Priority Ship-To opened on the 20th of a month, with a request on the 20th of the month 60 calendar months later, has 60 whole months: 7 percent. A request on the 19th of that month gives 59 whole months: neither rate.
- A Corbett Premier Route Ship-To open 61 whole months: 10 percent.
